messages:
paul: Morning — quick async rollcall for API gateway / routing / auth / rate limits.
paul: What I did: shipped a small fix to route weighting to avoid request loops (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/289).
paul: Blocker: seeing intermittent 429s on /v1/generate in the CANARY pool, mostly from thin mobile clients.
paul: Today: investigate KV cache eviction behavior and run targeted canary repro.

maya: saw those 429s too. Logs point to short bursts from mobile SDKs, client_id spikes. I opened infra issue #392.
maya: Quick mitigation I tried: bumped per-route token bucket to 200/s on canary to buy time (staging applied). :warning:

jun: on auth side — rotated JWT signing key yesterday. Confirmed expiry still 1h, but some tokens fail with invalid_kid -> 401.
jun: Plan: implement graceful key rollover (accept old kid for 24h) and add metrics for kid-mismatch. Will PR today.
jeff-bot: (automated) New alert rule created: auth.invalid_kid_rate > 0.5% over 5m -> notify #eng-oncall.

eve: worked on the rate-limit telemetry dashboard, added per-client heatmap and per-route token counters. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/rl/heatmap
eve: Noticed ~12 client_ids causing 60-90% of bursts. I'll add an alert at 70% qps/window.

paul: @jun can you paste a sample of the token error logs? Also can we prefer client_id throttles over global bucket increases for canary?

jun: sample log below: ```json
{"path":"/v1/generate","status":401,"error":"invalid_kid","kid":"old-key-abc123","ts":"2026-03-17T03:15:22Z"}
```

deploy-bot: Canary rollout report: deploy-2026-03-17-03-20 -> traffic 10% -> healthy (03:20 UTC). No pod restarts.

maya: Thanks. I'll revert the global per-route bucket bump on canary and instead add a client-id specific throttle rule. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/configs/pull/58 (WIP).

eve: FYI I added a temporary alert: rl-spike-canary > 80% for 5m -> pages oncall. Will tune threshold after we see a few cycles.

paul: Today's action items:
- jun: PR for key rollover + coordinate with mobile team for token refresh window.
- maya: client-id throttling config for canary (no global bump).
- eve: watch alert and adjust thresholds, share list of offending client_ids.
- paul: instrument KV cache eviction metrics and run repro against canary.

paul: If anyone wants to pair on the repro/debug, ping me.
jun: ack, I can pair at 11:30am PT.
maya: ack.
eve: ack, I'll keep the dashboard open and post updates here. :sparkles:
